semiconductor_relevance: High — CONNECTEC JAPAN specializes in chiplet packaging solutions, which are critical for advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: CONNECTEC JAPAN focuses on the development and production of diverse chiplet structures through its Chiplet Ameba Development Network (CADN). This initiative connects semiconductor companies in Japan to facilitate small-lot development and production, enabling customized chiplet packages tailored to specific project requirements.

regional_presence.Japan: CONNECTEC JAPAN operates within Japan, focusing on collaboration with local semiconductor companies.
